Seshat Evidence Hunt · صيد الأدلة مع سشات

Read the authentic passage and provide direct textual proof for the proposition.

Exercise and physical activity

Health experts regularly recommend that teenagers do at least 60 minutes of moderate-to-hard physical activity every day. This doesn't necessarily mean competitive sport. Activities such as cycling to school, swimming, or even a brisk walk, all count towards the daily target.

What makes exercise particularly powerful is its effect on the brain: physical activity causes the release of endorphins, chemicals that reduce feelings of stress and anxiety at the same time as boosting mood and self-confidence. Furthermore, teenagers who exercise regularly tend to sleep more deeply and report higher levels of concentration during school hours. Despite these well-documented benefits, a landmark WHO-led study found that more than 80% of teenagers worldwide fail to meet the recommended daily activity levels, largely due to sedentary screen-based habits.

Challenge Prompt:

Find and quote the sentence showing how physical activity affects psychological well-being.
